EVIDENCE BEFORE RELEASE

Scope Control

Scope Control workflow for coding agents. Use when related work threatens to distract from the active task.

Workflow

  1. Identify the requested outcome and supplied evidence.
  2. Complete requested scope; keep secondary findings in a separate backlog.
  3. Verify the output contract and preserve uncertainty.

Populated example

Request: Fix auth without rebuilding the dashboard.

Keep the auth repair active; record dashboard improvements for later.

Use the helper

partition_scope

Source: skills/scope-control/SKILL.md in the package. Use this workflow selectively; it does not override user or system instructions.
